persistent_lines.method: Mask +/-1 Welch bin around peaks with local excess >8 dB in >=60% of unsaturated records; 31-bin local median, peaks above 7.5 kHz. Recompute four spectral descriptors per analog channel; retain all temporal and coupling descriptors.
persistent_lines.caveat: Sensitivity test only. Persistent lines are not proven instrumental, and masking can remove real signals. No time-domain filtering.

phase_conditioned_counts.caveat: Cross-day empirical phase profile within SWEAP status, 600 bins; gain adjusted per event. Counts standardized by sqrt(expected+1), not a calibrated counting-noise model. Fine scan structure, timing drift, and rate changes can remain.
